'''Guowang Miao''' is a system engineer and researcher focusing on next-generation mobile Internet and wireless systems. He researches primarily the design, [[signal processing]], and optimization of cloud platforms and networking systems. He is the author of ''Fundamentals of Mobile Data Networks'' and ''Energy and Spectrum Efficient Wireless Network Design''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://ajofefamoknu.bloggersdelight.dk/fundamentals-of-mobile-data-networks-download/|title=Fundamentals of Mobile Data Networks download|website=Ajofefamoknu.bloggersdelight.dk|accessdate=1 November 2016}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.utdallas.edu/~kehtar/ieee-sp/10-26-11-IEEE-seminar.pdf|title=Cross-Layer Design for Energy-Efficient Wireless Communications|author=Dr. Guowang Miao|website=Utdallas.edu|accessdate=27 November 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.csit.carleton.ca/~fyu/MCV15/program/program.html|title=Program|website=Csit.carleton.ca|accessdate=1 November 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://automation.sjtu.edu.cn/userfiles/files/A%20Lecture%20by%20%20%20Dr_%20Guowang%20Miao.pdf |title=Archived copy |access-date=2016-11-01 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161103215504/http://automation.sjtu.edu.cn/userfiles/files/A%20Lecture%20by%20%20%20Dr_%20Guowang%20Miao.pdf |archive-date=2016-11-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite book|url=http://www.pandora.com.tr/urun/fundamentals-of-mobile-data-networks/487620|title=Pandora - Fundamentals of Mobile Data Networks - Guowang Miao - Kitap - | isbn = 9781107143210|first=Pandora Yayın ve Kitap Hizmetleri|last=A.Ş.|website=Pandora.com.tr|date=3 March 2016 |accessdate=1 November 2016}}</ref><ref name="kth.se">{{cite web |title=Guowang Miao - Researcher |url=https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/author/37411059000 |access-date=1 Jan 2023 |website=[[IEEE]]}}</ref><ref name="eitdigital.eu"/><ref>[http://ar.newsmth.net/thread-16c6f054a2b3a96.html] {{dead link|date=November 2017}}</ref>

==Education==
Guowang Miao received his bachelor's degree from [[Tsinghua University]] and his master's degree and Ph.D. from [[Georgia Institute of Technology]], Atlanta.<ref name="kth.se"/>

==Career==
Guowang Miao worked with [[intel|Intel Labs]] as a Research Engineer, Samsung Research America as a Senior Standard Engineer and a [[3GPP]] LTE-A RAN1/4 Delegate, and KTH first as an Assistant Professor and then as a tenured Associate Professor and Docent.<ref name="kth.se"/>

He won an Individual Gold Award from [[Samsung|Samsung Telecom America]], in 2011, for his work on LTE-A standardization.<ref name="kth.se"/>

During his services for various organizations, he has published more than 100 research papers, some of which are [[Essential Science Indicators]] (ESI) highly cited.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://esi.incites.thomsonreuters.com/IndicatorsAction.action|title=InCites™ [v2.32] - Sign In|website=Esi.incites.thomsonreuters.com|access-date=1 November 2016}}{{Dead link|date=January 2020 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>G.
